_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
Smart Cuff v3.2.79 organizes SysID into scan setup, run status, measured results and saved runs. PID gains share Kp/Ki/Kd headings, with separate timing/output, feedback and Apply cards. Buttons align and the report grows with content before scrolling.

The complete startup logo now has a small firmware version and stable release date below it. Startup remains one second.

All OLED screens retain a two-pixel guard around every edge. Rounded headers/frames and lower text move inward; long complete labels can use the smaller font. Both transfer paths and the authoritative GUI mirror retain the same inset framebuffer.

Control gains, equations, safety thresholds, calibration, timing and branch-specific presets are unchanged. Default retains its automatic pulse-preservation control; Valinor retains its Max80–220 menu. Independent SysID HIGH repeat disagreement remains rejected and the saved tuning is retained. This release does not claim cross-cuff, pulse-preservation or population qualification.

Validation and protected flash/readback/ten-minute seed-213 soak evidence are archived in gui/recordings/followup280_delivery. Installers use the existing verified branch feed and protected firmware-alignment path.
